description: Separate Erza result image references, settle each completed choice once using the existing half-point helper, and give unique Erza fixed peerless appearance with latent guaranteed discovery through existing state handling.

edits.new:
IF interaction_city = 66677921:
 npc = 0
 $npc_id = ''
 $place = 'erza_battle'
 $return_lock = 'menu_form'
 $special_image[1] = 'scene\others\erza_dead_after_1.png'
! JO9 MOD START ERZA_BRANCH_IMAGES_TRAITS_20261101
 ! The two result counters together identify an already completed mutually exclusive choice.
 if city_already_done_ever['66677921'] = 0 and city_already_done_ever['66677922'] = 0:
  gs 'jo9_cruel_mercy_apply', 6
 end
! JO9 MOD END ERZA_BRANCH_IMAGES_TRAITS_20261101

IF interaction_city = 66677922:
 npc = 0
 $npc_id = ''
 $place = 'erza_battle'
 $return_lock = 'menu_form'
 $special_image[1] = 'scene\others\erza_dead_after_2.png'
! JO9 MOD START ERZA_BRANCH_IMAGES_TRAITS_20261101
 ! The two result counters together identify an already completed mutually exclusive choice.
 if city_already_done_ever['66677921'] = 0 and city_already_done_ever['66677922'] = 0:
  gs 'jo9_cruel_mercy_apply', -2
 end
! JO9 MOD END ERZA_BRANCH_IMAGES_TRAITS_20261101

! JO9 MOD START ERZA_BRANCH_IMAGES_TRAITS_20261101
! Repair only the retired shared reference in cached result pages; do not replay choices.
if $replace($special_image[1], '\', '/') = 'scene/others/erza_dead_after.png':
 if interaction_city = 66677921: $special_image[1] = 'scene\others\erza_dead_after_1.png'
 if interaction_city = 66677922: $special_image[1] = 'scene\others\erza_dead_after_2.png'
end
! JO9 MOD END ERZA_BRANCH_IMAGES_TRAITS_20261101
! JO9 MOD START BG_DIRECTORY_PREFIX_FIX_20261027

local $jo9_meiki_found_name = ''
! JO9 MOD END MEIKI_DISCOVERY_POPUP_LOCAL_20261026
! JO9 MOD START ERZA_BRANCH_IMAGES_TRAITS_20261101
! Erza has a fixed latent trait; unexperienced states stay unchanged and hidden.
local $jo9_erza_meiki_role = $args[0]
if instr('|slave|assistant|room1|room2|room3|room4|', '|' + $jo9_erza_meiki_role + '|') > 0:
 if dyneval('result = ' + $jo9_erza_meiki_role + '_type') = 2624:
  if func('jo9_meiki_checks', 'age', dyneval('result = ' + $jo9_erza_meiki_role + "['age']")) = 1:
   if dyneval('result = ' + $jo9_erza_meiki_role + "['virginity']") >= 2 and dyneval('result = ' + $jo9_erza_meiki_role + "['virginity']") ! 4 and dyneval('result = ' + $jo9_erza_meiki_role + "['jo9_meiki_known']") = 0:
    dynamic $jo9_erza_meiki_role + "['jo9_meiki_known'] = 1"
    jo9_meiki_found = 1
    $jo9_meiki_found_name = $dyneval('$result = $' + $jo9_erza_meiki_role + '_name')
   end
  end
 end
end
! JO9 MOD END ERZA_BRANCH_IMAGES_TRAITS_20261101
